label_readings_from_a_superseded_build.reason:
These nine label readings carry no host, or one this check cannot parse, so they cannot be shown to describe the declared Logic build. They are not known to be WRONG - they predate the provenance format settling - and re-reading each one needs a live Logic in its locale, which is why they are carried rather than closed. The dimension itself is new in this commit, so this is its starting ceiling; from here it may only shrink.

2026-09-15 addition: Two records written 2026-09-15 for the automation lane and the Control Surface Setup. Both reverify MANUALLY: one toggles a view and drives elements whose effect has to be watched, the other opens a window and reads one field, and scripting either on an operator's machine buys less than a person following the steps. Neither cites an evidence file separate from the census they share, which is why they land in records_without_evidence as well.

manual_reverify.reason:
The ko-KR New Project chooser record reverifies MANUALLY: reaching that window needs every project closed, which discards unsaved work, and a script that does that on an operator's machine is worse than a person following four steps. Carried for that reason, not for want of trying to script it.

2026-09-15 addition (control surface): Re-verifying the control-surface install means installing a control surface: it writes to the user's Logic configuration and needs a live server so the MCU port exists to bind to. Scripting that would mean shipping a script whose whole job is to mutate somebody's setup on demand, which is a worse thing to have lying around than a paragraph of steps.

records_without_evidence.reason: The ledger was deleted on 2026-09-13 together with the release-qualification subsystem and restored on 2026-09-15. These members are the gaps that opened in the two days nothing was counting them: label variants and records written on 2026-09-13 and 2026-09-14 for the transport display-mode work, the MIDI-import panel and the German locale readings. They are admitted as a starting ceiling rather than closed, because closing them needs live readings and a raise is the honest way to carry a gap somebody has looked at. The guard that would have refused them at the time did not exist; it does now, and it refuses this file without this entry.

surfaces_without_records.reason: de-DE joined the supported locales on 2026-09-12 (#876), so every surface SURFACES.md names now owes a German record and eight have none. Adding a locale makes the existing gap visible in one more column rather than creating a new one.

2026-09-15 addition (control surface): The eight Control Surface Setup/Install window labels are measured in ko-KR only, live on 2026-09-15 (record `2026-09-15-the-setup-windows-own-menu-installs-the-surface`). Their menu PATH is measured in all four locales — `Control Surfaces` and `Setup…`/`Settings…` come from the navigation-free censuses — but nothing has opened these two WINDOWS on an en-US, ja-JP or de-DE Logic, so their canonicals are Apple's published English and carry no reading on this host. They are deliberately left as a counted gap rather than given translated variants: #883 established that a plausible guess looks right and matches nothing, which is worse than an honest absence. Closing each needs the Setup window opened on a Logic running that language, with a server alive so the port popups are populated.
